decisions.checklistNumbering: 1-653 plus CL-DK and CL1-CL6 disambiguate overlapping printed checklist numbers.
decisions.variations: One canonical card per number, corrected/later b state. No extra completion requirements for errors or print variations.
decisions.exclusions: Oversized Super Diamond Kings were wrapper-redemption cards; box bottoms were packaging; puzzle panels were non-card accompaniments. Separate Leaf, Highlights, All-Stars and The Rookies products excluded.
decisions.subsets: Diamond Kings 1-26, Rated Rookies 27-46, King of Kings 653 remain in base.
